New request 84bf9677 is not authorized; historical budgets remain closed. Zero real model calls, assets, reserved access, training or default changes.
Program digest identifies instructions/schema; request/call binds source data. Source freeze is not a hermetic or authenticated remote-model environment.

summary: Add a trusted, explicit program catalog via existing generation digest. Candidate v4.1 refines relational rule classification and question materiality; legacy v4.0/default, schema, audit and expectations preserved. Route one uniform version across runtime/replay without rewriting bad outputs. Efficacy unobserved.
